prompt:
Edit the existing Trash-panel candidate using the primary original screenshot crop as the visual authority. Preserve the exact current canvas proportions (about 0.88:1), panel bounds, search field, row count and order, Japanese wording, row spacing, restore/trash actions, fixed retention footer, colors, rounded panel frame, and bottom clipping. The corrected primary crop isolates the panel at x=294,y=582,w=526,h=598. Use the Japanese mock only for translated labels/titles.

Make these targeted corrections to the existing candidate: (1) Replace the three outlined filter cards with the source's native control treatment. 「最後の編集者」 is the only selected filter: a compact pale-blue rounded pill with blue person icon, blue text and blue chevron. 「場所」 and 「チーム領域」 are plain unboxed inline dropdown controls on the white panel, with neutral-gray page/building icons, dark-gray labels and light-gray chevrons; no surrounding border, card, fill, or container around either. Match the original crop's relative widths and compact height. (2) Reduce the row-title weight from bold to the moderate medium/semibold weight seen in the original Notion source; keep subtitles regular gray and preserve the current readable Japanese glyphs. Do not alter the Japanese strings or their order.

Keep the eighth 「掲示の資料」 row partially obscured by the fixed footer, as in the source. Keep the footer text 「30日を過ぎたページは自動で削除されます。」 and the small help icon aligned at far right. Do not add rows, outer whitespace, labels, badges, or controls. The source crop controls geometry, state and visual weight; the Japanese mock guides Japanese copy only.
reviewNotes: v002 corrected v001 filter styling: blue selected Last editor pill, plain Location and Teamspaces dropdowns, and lighter source-matched title weight. Candidate aspect 1176x1337 (0.8796) matches corrected source crop 526x598 (0.8796); Japanese labels, eight source-ordered rows with the eighth partly clipped, restore/delete controls and 30-day footer visually checked.
